interpretation.relative_error: ||a-b||/(||b||+1e-12); reference_norm affects degeneracy only. FD b=exact HVP; correction b=Delta_quad; matched effective b=SAM.
interpretation.curvature_phase: All formal curvature e1/e10/e25 cells are in the pre-switch phase; cell means are within seed and branch/epoch/scale/precision before across-seed sample SD.
interpretation.matching_geometry: Ideal finite FP64 BA and all FC geometry from represented native FP32 parameters/gradients; not an actually rounded FP32 optimizer commit.
interpretation.fixed_vs_fit: Fixed e25/e50 paired values above are distinct estimands from the first-common-CE-bin fit matching in state_analysis.
interpretation.scientific_vs_execution: Execution receipt and exit 0 never imply HVP convergence, correction agreement, or a causal mechanism.
